The content explicitly addresses both the advantages (structural and compositional aspects) and disadvantages (limited subdivision of variants) of the ontology design.

evidence.excerpt:
Advantages And Disadvantages
4. Advantages and disadvantages
The advantages of this ontology focuses on the structural and compositional aspects of a sandwich, like
how many slices of bread it has, how many ﬁlling layers, and the distinction between meat and
vegetable ingredients. This will help it to keep a clear and focused scope.
The disadvantage of this structure is that there is little further subdivision of the variants. All variants are
below Sandwich, it can be harder to capture more detailed groupings or shared behaviour among
subsets of sandwiches.
evidence.description: Section discussing the strengths and limitations of the ontology.
